newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 30.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Monday were within Friday's quotes amid thin enquiries, traders said. Bunker 380-cst was indicated at around $120 per tonne with 180-cst at $124-$125. A trader said, as prices were still high, in comparison with levels in South Korea and Fujiarah, there are no incentives to refuel in Singapore. MDO were quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $215-$220. -- Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
